hook_text: Find the little maize cobs on a farming map and you have found the bread basket of South Africa.
clip_script: A map of South Africa fills the screen. Little symbols pop up one by one: yellow maize cobs across the Free State and North West, green sugar cane along the KwaZulu-Natal coast, orange dots in Limpopo, bunches of grapes in the Western Cape. Then the animals arrive: sheep spread across the dry Karoo, cattle in the grasslands. Look at the key and the map tells a story. The wetter east grows crops. The drier west feeds sheep.
visual_style: Whiteboard outline of South Africa with simple symbols appearing in each farming area, a key box in the corner, and an arrow from wet east to dry west.
mood: Curious and clever, like a detective solving a puzzle.
pacing: One symbol at a time, then the big pattern revealed at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw three farming symbols for your own map key.
